empiricalCorrelations32Teams.pair: Net Point Differential/G vs. Win Percentage
empiricalCorrelations32Teams.bettingImplication: Confirms scoring margin per game explains the majority of win-rate variance across all 32 clubs.

empiricalCorrelations32Teams.pair: Pythagorean Skill Win % vs. Actual Win %
empiricalCorrelations32Teams.bettingImplication: Residual (1 - r^2) isolates single-score sequencing & turnover luck from underlying team scoring skill.

empiricalCorrelations32Teams.pair: Offensive Net Yards/Dropback vs. Points For/G
empiricalCorrelations32Teams.bettingImplication: Passing efficiency net of sack yardage is the single strongest offensive unit predictor of scoring.

empiricalCorrelations32Teams.pair: Offensive Passer Rating vs. Win Percentage
empiricalCorrelations32Teams.bettingImplication: Explains why starter-to-backup QB downgrades (e.g. SEA, MIA Week 10) trigger the largest fair-line shifts.

empiricalCorrelations32Teams.pair: Offensive Sack Rate Allowed % vs. Points For/G
empiricalCorrelations32Teams.bettingImplication: Negative correlation quantifies how 2nd/3rd-string OL protection breakdowns suppress team scoring.
High correlation validates 3rd-down conversion rate as a key total & team-total input.

empiricalCorrelations32Teams.pair: Pass Turnover Differential (Def INT - Off INT) vs. Net Pts/G
empiricalCorrelations32Teams.bettingImplication: Strong contemporaneous correlation, but high week-to-week randomness requires shrinkage in forward lines.

empiricalCorrelations32Teams.pair: Defensive Passer Rating Allowed vs. Points Allowed/G
empiricalCorrelations32Teams.bettingImplication: Positive correlation shows coverage breakdowns in 2nd/3rd-string secondaries inflate points allowed.

empiricalCorrelations32Teams.pair: Defensive Rush Yards/Carry Allowed vs. Points Allowed/G
empiricalCorrelations32Teams.bettingImplication: Measures scoring bleed when DL/LB injuries compromise interior gap integrity.

empiricalCorrelations32Teams.pair: Offensive Rush Attempts/G vs. Win Percentage
empiricalCorrelations32Teams.bettingImplication: Positive game-script link: leading teams run more in Q3/Q4 (penalize naive SGP pricing on RB Att Over + Favorite).

empiricalCorrelations32Teams.pair: Offensive Pass Attempts/G vs. Win Percentage
empiricalCorrelations32Teams.bettingImplication: Negative/weak link: trailing teams abandon the run and inflate pass volume (key for QB Att Over + Underdog scripts).

empiricalCorrelations32Teams.pair: Offensive Pass Yards/G vs. Offensive Rush Yards/G
empiricalCorrelations32Teams.bettingImplication: Near-zero team-level correlation shows passing and rushing yardage volumes substitute across game scripts.

vigAndParlayMath.skillRequirement: Must originate true win prob > 52.381% (or beat no-vig closing line > +2.38%)
Vig compounds multiplicatively: 8.88% hold on 50/50 legs; BOTH legs need >52.381% skill edge.
13.03% house hold on coin-flip legs; amplifies +EV only if every leg is independently +CLV.

vigAndParlayMath.betStructure: 2-Leg Positively Correlated SGP (P(A)=0.50, P(B)=0.50, r=+0.35 Gaussian Copula)
vigAndParlayMath.skillRequirement: True joint hit rate rises from 25.00% to ~30.65% (fair +226); profitable ONLY if book quotes > +226.
